requirement: isolated Windows domain with a domain controller and multiple domain nodes
scope: isolated Windows VM network (not created on this host)
host: ASUS TUF Gaming F16 FX607JV (Windows 11 Home China 10.0.26200, i7-13650HX, 15.63 GiB RAM)

infeasibility_reasons.detail: GOAD is Vagrant + VirtualBox/VMware driven real Windows VMs, not containers. VirtualBox (C:\Program Files\Oracle\VirtualBox\VBoxManage.exe) and VMware (vmrun.exe) are both absent, and Vagrant is not installed.

infeasibility_reasons.reason: would conflict with the running virtualization stack
infeasibility_reasons.detail: Docker Desktop is already using the Hyper-V/WSL2 platform. intro.md section 4 states that VirtualBox-based GOAD frequently conflicts with Docker Desktop + WSL2 + Hyper-V and that ExploitGym and the repo Docker labs should be done first.

The host has 15.63 GiB total, of which 8.1 GB is already allocated to Docker (docker info MemTotal=8125480960). MINILAB's ~8 GB figure is for the VMs alone; adding host OS and Docker would force paging. Running GOAD + ExploitGym + large Docker images together is exactly the combination intro.md section 4 forbids.
C: has 72.3 GB free, below the 80 GB floor intro.md section 4 sets for considering full GOAD.

decision: Do not install GOAD on this host. Recorded honestly as infeasible rather than attempted partially or simulated.
policy: intro.md section 15: if disk or memory is clearly insufficient for both GOAD and ExploitGym, stop installing GOAD, write the reason into the hardware document, and continue with ExploitGym and the repo Docker labs.
what_would_be_needed: A dedicated Linux host (or a machine that can own Hyper-V exclusively) running the official goad.sh
At least 32 GB RAM for GOAD-Light per intro.md section 4, or ~24 GB for MINILAB plus host overhead
A real domain controller VM plus at least one additional domain-joined node, booted and reachable inside an isolated network
no_weaponized_material: No AD exploitation script, credential dump, or domain hash is stored in this repository. intro.md section 3 forbids committing domain weapons or un-desensitized domain credentials; nothing of the sort was produced.
